title: Around the Air Force: Show of Force / Hurricane Harvey Rescue / Carpathian Summer
description: On this look around the Air Force, Airmen conduct a show of force with allies, rescue victims of Hurricane Harvey, and train with the Romania military. Hosted by SSgt Samantha Ducker
keywords: show of force, Carpathian Summer, Around the Air Force, ATAF, Featured Videos, Hurricane Harvey, Romania, c

transcript.text: ^- Hey there everyone, I'm Staff Sergeant Samantha Ducker
^with your Look Around the Air Force.
^In response to a North Korean missile launch US Marine Core
^F-35B Lightning II Stealth Fighters joined US Air Force
^B-1B Lancers for the first time in a sequence bilateral
^mission with Japan and Republic of Korea Air Forces.
^US Pacific command maintained strategic bomber and fighter
^capabilities in the Indo-Asia Pacific theater.
^Retaining the ability to respond to any
^regional threat at a moment's notice.
^Airmen from around the US continue to help with relief
^efforts in Houston Texas after hurricane Harvey.
^Airmen from the 106 Rescue Wing flew a rescue mission
^to save people trapped by floods using an HH-60 Pave Hawk
^helicopter Airmen were able to save men, women, children,
^and even dogs from the flood.
^To see the full video check out Airmen magazine on Facebook.
^Over in the European theater, Airmen from Rammstein Airbase
^have returned home after a bilateral training exercise in
^Romania, about 160 Airmen along with three
^C-130J Super Hercules Aircraft conducted combined
^air operations with the Romanian Air Force.
^Romanian observers joined the US Air Force on every flight.
^- It's been a, pretty cool situation to be to learn from
^them and for them to be able to come along and ride with us.
^- The exercise aimed to strengthen relationships with
^NATO partners and maintain joint readiness.
To stay up to date on Air Force news check out af.mil
also be sure to subscribe to our YouTube page,
just search aftv Radio,
and that's your look Around the Air Force.
